_comment: Claude Code's part of the agent layer, read by scripts/deploy_agent.py. src is relative to agent/common (or to this folder when a target sets from to harness: the Claude-only refine skill and its refiner agent), dest to $HOME. The shim is the one line ~/.claude/CLAUDE.md must hold; deploy checks it and never writes the file. This folder's install.json places the status line and the cc-status mod.
